title: The theory of variational hybrid quantum-classical algorithms
problem_summary: Extends the general theory of the VQE hybrid quantum-classical optimization scheme, develops a variational adiabatic ansatz, and explores unitary coupled cluster within that theoretical framework, suggesting algorithmic improvements for practical implementation.

components.family_or_name: general theory of hybrid quantum-classical variational optimization
components.notes: Foundational theory paper extending the original VQE proposal's formal framework, not a single-system experimental demonstration.

workflow_composition_notes: Theoretical/methodological paper; formalizes the variational hybrid loop structure that subsequent experimental VQE papers (e.g. omalley2016, kandala2017) build on.
